verdict.rationale: Adyen documents a public API surface for driving the product. It covers Checkout API requests (/sessions, /paymentMethods, /payments, /payments/details), Management API operations, idempotency keys, and scoped API credentials. Its OpenAPI specifications, described as the 'single source of truth' for every public API, are published on GitHub. An official MCP server wraps these APIs for LLM clients, and a consultant's hands-on report confirms a working integration. missing for 10: independent verification of a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probes of the docs domain returned 404, and the specs are cited only via the GitHub repo); community reports that integration is complex compared with competitors.
